description: Build-time inventory, not a promise of deployment availability. Discover tools/list for current schemas, models and enabled services. All tools are accessible through the single Creative OS MCP connection; this file is not an allowlist.

skills.name: build-advertiser-intelligence
skills.description: Understand an advertiser by delegating focused research jobs and reviewing the returned answers in Creative OS.

tools.title: Scrape web page
tools.description: Fetch a web page (and optionally linked pages) and return the main content as clean text and Markdown.

url.description: The page to fetch and extract readable content from

maxPages.description: How many linked pages to crawl, starting from the URL

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Google search
tools.description: Run a Google search and return the organic results.

query.description: The Google search query to run

maxResults.description: Maximum number of organic results to return

countryCode.description: Two-letter country code to localize results, e.g. "us"

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Instagram profile lookup
tools.description: Return public profile details for one or more Instagram usernames.

usernames.description: Instagram handles to fetch public profile details for

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Instagram reel scraper
tools.description: Scrape Instagram reels from profiles or reel URLs — caption, timestamp, transcript, hashtags, mentions, likes, comments, views, shares, and duration.

usernames.description: Instagram usernames, profile URLs, IDs, or direct reel URLs. Each is processed individually.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum reels to scrape per profile (ignored for direct reel URLs).

onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Only reels from this date/time to now. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, a full ISO timestamp, or relative time like "2 weeks". Evaluated in UTC.

skipPinnedPosts.description: Exclude pinned reels from the results.

skipTrialReels.description: Exclude trial reels (creator test reels shown to non-followers).

includeSharesCount.description: Extract each reel's share count. Paid add-on.

includeTranscript.description: Extract a text transcript of the reel audio. Paid add-on, charged per minute.

includeDownloadedVideo.description: Download and store a copy of the reel video. Paid add-on, charged per MB.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Instagram hashtag scraper
tools.description: Scrape Instagram posts or reels by hashtag or keyword — captions, locations, likes, plays, comments, images, timestamps, and related hashtags.

hashtags.description: Hashtags or keywords, with or without a leading #. Each entry is one search term.

keywordSearch.description: Search by keyword instead of hashtag. Keywords may contain spaces; the returned fields differ slightly from hashtag results.

resultsType.description: Whether to scrape posts, reels, or stories for each term.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum results per hashtag or keyword.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Meta ad library scraper
tools.description: Scrape Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Audience Network) ads from the Ad Library by keyword, Page ID, or Ad Library URL — creatives, copy, CTAs, and impressions/spend data where Meta makes it available.

keyword.description: Search term or brand name, e.g. "nike".

adLibraryUrl.description: Full Meta Ad Library URL, including its search parameters.

maxResults.description: How many ads to collect; pagination stops at this count.

sortBy.description: total_impressions: Meta's impression ordering. most_recent: Meta's relevancy/monthly view. Sorting already present in adLibraryUrl takes precedence.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: TikTok scraper
tools.description: Scrape TikTok videos by hashtag, profile, search query, or direct URL — captions, author, engagement metrics, sound, and duration.

searchQueries.description: Free-text search terms applied to videos and profiles.

postURLs.description: Direct TikTok video URLs to scrape.

resultsPerPage.description: Max videos per hashtag / profile / query.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: YouTube scraper
tools.description: Scrape YouTube videos by search term or channel/video URL — title, channel, views, likes, comments, duration, and description.

searchQueries.description: YouTube search terms, as typed in the search bar.

videoUrls.description: YouTube video, channel, or playlist URLs.

maxResults.description: Max videos to collect (per query or channel).

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Instagram reels downloader
tools.description: Download Instagram reels/posts by URL and return direct, downloadable media links (video/image variants).

links.description: Instagram reel or post URLs to download.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: YouTube video downloader
tools.description: Download YouTube videos (360p–4K) and return a link to the stored file.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Facebook video downloader
tools.description: Download a Facebook video/reel by URL and return direct, downloadable media links with quality variants.

url.description: A Facebook video or reel URL (e.g. an fb.watch link).

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Generate image
tools.description: Generate or edit images from a prompt and optional image/video references using gpt_image_2, nano_banana, nano_banana_2, nano_banana_pro, nano_banana_2_lite. Images are stored and returned as URLs.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

aspectRatio.description: Output aspect-ratio enum: ONE_BY_ONE (square), FOUR_BY_FIVE (portrait feed), SIXTEEN_BY_NINE or FOUR_BY_THREE (landscape), NINE_BY_SIXTEEN or THREE_BY_FOUR (portrait).

resolution.description: Output resolution for supported Nano Banana models.

outputFormat.description: File format for GPT Image output.

referenceImages.description: Ordered image references used to preserve subjects, products, characters, composition, or style.

referenceVideos.description: Video references for supported Gemini models; fps controls frame sampling and defaults to 0.5.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Animate image
tools.description: Create a short Seedance video from role-aware image references and optional video references, persist the result, and return a signed URL.

prompt.description: Motion, action, camera, and audio direction for the clip.

referenceImages.description: One or more public or signed HTTPS image references and their roles.

referenceVideos.description: Optional HTTPS videos used in general reference mode.

projectId.description: Creative OS project ID. Use creative_os_list_projects first.

tools.title: Load specialist guidance locally
tools.description: Read specialist domain guidance to apply in this chat using the available local tools. This does not launch an agent, change tool permissions, or spend a cloud job budget. Roles: brand-brain, business, competitors, customers, image-creative, organic, paid, review, synthesis.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Publish work plan
tools.description: Return a work plan for display in this conversation before dispatch. Use unique task IDs and reuse them when starting jobs. This does not dispatch or persist a plan.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Start specialist job
tools.description: Give a specialist a question, bounded scope and the relevant context directly. Do not refer it to skill files or research-pack documents. Creative OS binds identity and stores the returned answer. Budgets are US cents; use bounded amounts justified by the user's requested work. Provide the same taskId only when checking/retrying an identical dispatch. Available workers: []

conceptCount.description: Required for image-creative: the number of distinct concepts selected by the user.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Check specialist job
tools.description: Read the current job status and stored answer. Cursor does not subscribe to Creative OS web chat progress. Reuse the returned task ID for bounded status checks; never redispatch a running job. Report pending work honestly.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Read saved specialist work
tools.description: Retrieve a checkpoint, dataset or other saved artifact from a job in this project, including an interrupted job. Omit key to list artifacts. Use saved context when deliberately resuming work; do not blindly repeat charged calls.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Choose concept count
tools.description: Return the brief for a concept-count question. If the user has not specified a count, ask for 1–12 concepts in chat and wait for their choice. This does not render a picker or start generation.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Read image ad resources
tools.description: List uploaded project image assets with IDs/URLs, connected image models and saved concepts. Pass relevant product/logo/style assets and brand knowledge to the image-creative specialist. This does not generate images.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Review image ad concepts
tools.description: Save draft image ad concepts without generating media. Import a completed image-creative job using taskId, or supply concepts using this schema. Read each saved concept with creative_os_get_image_ad and show its exact prompt and references for review. Cursor does not render Creative OS web chat approval cards. Saving is not approval.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Read image ad
tools.description: Read a saved concept, revision, exact generation prompt, references and image/video status. Use its current revision for edits or explicitly authorized production. No automatic web chat polling occurs in Cursor.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Edit image ad draft
tools.description: Update a saved draft's prompt, model and aspect ratio using its current revision. Read the draft first. Does not approve or generate.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Approve image ad generation
tools.description: Queue metered image generation for a saved draft at the exact reviewed revision. Call only when the user has authorized generation of that concept. Return queued status truthfully; read the result with creative_os_get_image_ad.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Retry image ad generation
tools.description: Retry a failed or uncertain generation at the current revision only after the user requests a retry and any uncertain provider charge is reconciled. This may incur a new charge.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.

tools.title: Animate image ad
tools.description: Queue metered video generation from a saved concept and project image at the current revision, only when the user requests that video. Read completion with creative_os_get_image_ad.

projectId.description: Selected Creative OS project ID. Discover with creative_os_list_projects.
